question: If 5x ⁻ y = 3125 and 3³x ⁺ y = 2187 , then the value of 19x - 18y is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

3125 = 5⁵ ⇒ x − y = 5

2187 = 3⁷ ⇒ 3x + y = 7

Solve ⇒ x = 3, y = −2

19x − 18y = 19×3 − 18(−2)

= 57 + 36 = 93

**∴ Answer = 93**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5x − y = 3125

3³x ⁺ y = 2187

**Formula used:**

am = aⁿ ⇒ m = n

**Calculation:**

⇒ 3125 = 5⁵

⇒ x − y = 5 ...(1)

⇒ 2187 = 3⁷

⇒ 3x + y = 7 ...(2)

⇒ Add (1) and (2)

⇒ 4x = 12 ⇒ x = 3

⇒ Substitute in (1)

⇒ 3 − y = 5 ⇒ y = −2

⇒ 19x − 18y = 19×3 − 18(−2)

⇒ = 57 + 36

⇒ = 93

**∴ The correct answer is 93.**
